name: Ruincraft ChillSkin Chrome Sleeve
description: Single-sleeve arm wrap designed to slide over chrome limbs and active augmentation, in pale grey phase-change fabric that absorbs body heat and releases it slowly. Street-brand construction — raw-edge hems, hand-stitched cooling gel channels, no branding except a small stamped ruin-cross on the wrist cuff. Prevents chrome overheating in 35C+ humidity without restricting movement.
functionality: Passive phase-change cooling for chrome limbs, gel-channel heat absorption, prevents aug overheating.
what_it_says: You've got chrome and you live somewhere that doesn't give you climate control — this is the solution.
story_hooks: The cooling gel channels are filled with something that isn't the standard compound — it works better, but nobody will say what it is.
Wearing one marks you as Shelf-born to anyone who grew up there.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist arm wrap that clings to the forearm and bicep with an asymmetrical, almost skeletal aesthetic. The pale grey fabric has a faint shimmer suggesting embedded cooling matrix. Worn alone or layered under jackets, it reads as practical street-tech rather than fashion.
physical_description.fit: Compression-style, form-fitting to the augmented limb without restrictive binding. Slides on easily, stays in place through friction-fit alone. Tapers slightly at wrist and shoulder, leaving the palm and upper chest bare.
physical_description.primary_material: Phase-change synthetic polymer weave — a hybrid of ballistic-grade base with thermally-reactive microfibers. Pale grey with a subtle pearlescent undertone that shifts in direct light.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost cool to the touch. Embossed with barely-perceptible linear channels that run from shoulder to wrist — these are the hand-stitched cooling gel conduits, visible as faint raised lines under raking light. Raw, intentionally frayed hems at the shoulder and wrist.
physical_description.color_scheme: Pale industrial grey (near-white), no patterns. The phase-change material creates subtle gradient shifts from pale to soft blue-grey as it absorbs thermal energy. Accent: small black stamped ruin-cross symbol at the inner wrist.
physical_description.closures: None. Pure friction-fit design — the compression weave grips chrome and skin equally, with no zippers, snaps, or buckles.
distinctive_features: Visible hand-stitched cooling gel channels running the length of the sleeve
Raw, unfinished hems suggesting DIY street manufacture
Small stamped ruin-cross brand mark on inner wrist cuff — barely visible unless you know to look
No corporate branding or logos; purely functional aesthetic
Thermal-reactive color shift visible under heat load
Designed to fit chrome limbs seamlessly — no awkward gaps or bunching
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4–5 street manufacture. Affordable, no-frills construction that signals self-reliance and chrome-culture adoption. Not wealthy enough for corpo thermal systems, too smart for unmanaged overheating.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer is likely augmented (chrome limb, active cybernetic), street-level or sub-grade, and practical about maintenance. Signals independence from corpo supply chains and comfort with DIY tech. Common among mechanics, runners, independent contractors in high-heat environments.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn-in but functional. Raw hems may fray further with use. Fabric may show minor staining or discoloration from sweat and street grime. No visible tears, but the hand-stitching shows varied tension, suggesting amateur but dedicated construction.

image_prompt: Close-up fashion shot of a pale grey compression sleeve on a cybernetic chrome arm, pale skin meeting gunmetal chrome at the edge of the fabric. Raw-edge hems and faint stitched cooling channels visible. Model's wrist shows a tiny black ruin-cross stamp. Dark warehouse interior, harsh blue-white LED strip lighting reflecting off the chrome. Humid, 35-degree heat shimmer visible in air. Moody, utilitarian cyberpunk aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
